scene furlough1
: ...and that’s just one of the many reasons I don’t think children under the age of ten should be allowed in public spaces.
: Well said, Maya. Though, I’m a little confused as to why you’re the one kicking off this event when Ayane is the typical open-ended intro provider.
: Hey, I’m fine with Maya stealing the spotlight every now and then. It’s not like I have an infinite amount of stories to tell all of you like she does.
scene furlough2
: What does that mean? I’m pretty sure Maya is younger than you and it’s not exactly like she leads a very exciting life.
: Hey.
: What’s more exciting than immortality?
scene furlough3
: Are you immortal now? Or is this just one more inside joke between you, Ayane, and Sensei that I am not a part of because you are slowly removing me from both the Love Squad and your lives?
: I have no interest in the “Love Squad.” I simply wanted to share an opinion of mine. But if me having thoughts is going to be the cause of so many problems, I’ll just go back to being quiet.
scene furlough4
: So, what’s the plan now?
: I was thinking we could stop at that cafe with all of the cool parfaits again. But if nobody else is hungry, we can always just go back to my house and play games or something.
: Oh, yeah. About that. I forgot to tell you- I actually wound up making plans with somebody else today, so you guys can head over to...wherever without me.
scene furlough5
: Other plans? But we always go home together if we’re still around when our clubs finish meeting.
: And I’m sure we’ll continue to do that in the future! I just can’t today. Sorry, Ami.
scene furlough6
: Man. I was really hoping we’d get to use your black card. I always feel so important whenever we get to pay with that.
: Oh. What I actually meant to say there is that I will miss you and hope that whatever plans you made with someone I can only assume is Sana go well.
: Everything alright? It’s one thing to not provide the intro, but bailing on everyone isn’t exactly in-character for you.
: Mhm! Everything is totally cool. Just have a couple loose-ends I need to tie up before leaving school today. But I’ll meet up with you guys again once it’s all over.

: Well...have fun, I guess. The three of us will probably just go home if you’re not coming since I don’t want to have to share a parfait with Maya. She’ll eat it all. And Sensei doesn’t eat anything “cute.”
: It’s true. I have to remain masculine at all times or people won’t take me seriously anymore.
scene black
: I guess I’ll just wind up seeing you all back at Ami’s house, then! Bye bye!
Four becomes three as Ayane wanders away from those she loves the most.
It is not the only example of numbers becoming numbers in recent memory, but it is the one I am contractually obligated to inform you of right now.
But where is she going, I wonder? And what or who will she find when she gets there?
A snake? A rabbit? A bat? A cat?
scene furlough7

Or the human embodiment of a trash can pretending to be sentient as it leans against the hood of a stranger’s car and thinks to itself about why sexual assault is okay so long as the majority of parties orgasm.
Anyway, I’m done here.
I don’t want to stick around for this.
: Hey. I was beginning to think you weren’t going to show up.
: I wouldn’t have asked to meet you here if I was planning on ditching. Not all of us thrive on the amount of inconveniences we cause for those around us.
: Well, you know me. The “amount of inconveniences I cause for those around me” is what gets my motor running in the morning.
: And yet, despite that, I still took the time out of my extremely busy practice schedule to see you today. I’m such a good friend, aren’t I?
: Don’t give me that shit. We haven’t been friends in a long time.
scene furlough8
: Hmm...when did our friendship end again?
: Was it the time you came all over my hand at the beach house? Or was it the time we treated Sensei’s cock like a giant lollipop together?
: Come to think of it, it was probably the first time since you weren’t even wet when I tried to put my fingers in during the Dorm Wars. And that’s just plain unfriendly.
: Are you done?
scene furlough9
: I can be. Though, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t a little hopeful that the reason you called me out here today was to organize our next threesome.
: Or twosome. I’d let you fuck me alone if you want. Or vice versa. See, I’ve been practicing this thing with my tongue where-
: We’re done.
scene furlough10
: Done?
: It’s over. I’m not letting you hold my life hostage anymore.
: You want to keep seeing Sensei behind my back? Fine. But I’m done letting you come between us.
: Yeah, here’s the thing. That’s not really up to you, sweetheart.
scene furlough11
: Don’t call me “sweetheart,” you fragile little bitch. We both know you’re overcompensating for how insignificant and unneeded you feel right now.
: Ooooh. Where’d this side of you come from? It’s kind of turning me on.
: Do me a favor and kindly fuck off for the rest of forever, please. I don’t have time for this anymore.
: You don’t? What changed?
: Kirin.
: If you’re worried about Sensei falling for me instead, don’t. Like you said, I’m “insignificant” and “unneeded.”
: But I’m a great receptacle for his semen since he always seems to like it when I wrap my legs around him and make it so he can’t pull out.
scene furlough12
: Oh, but don’t worry about me getting pregnant. I’m on birth control, so he can cum inside of me as much as he wants and everything will be totally fine!
: In terms of actual raw, love though...don’t worry. I’m just not that type of girl.
: Fantastic. Can I take that as you agreeing to simply fuck him while I’m not around then? Or are you still going to try and drag all three of us under the sheets together?
scene furlough13
: Hmm...depends on how horny I am, I guess. Just Sensei won’t always do it for me, you know. I like having you around as well.
: You do this cute, little...high pitched yelp thing whenever you’re feeling good that makes me a lot hotter than any cock ever has, that’s for sure.
: I’m just not sure if I’m ready to give that up. Nor do I understand why I’d have to just because you decided to finally stand up to me.
scene furlough12

: Why you decided to stand up to me, I’m not sure. It’s not like having you point out my flaws and cry about how you don’t like me touching you is going to make me magically not want to do it anymore.
: Remember, Ayane- you’re the one who agreed to this little...arrangement in order to protect Sensei.
: If you’re going to try and back out of it, nothing’s stopping me from just telling everyone about the two of you and ruining both of your lives once and-
scene furlough14
: Do it.
: Huh?
: Fucking do it. I dare you.
: Ruin our lives.
: Tell the world about us and see what happens. Sensei will love me just the same.
: But you?
: You’ll never know what it’s like to feel what I feel. To feel any amount of love at all.
: So stop fucking chasing it, you hear me?
: Don’t you fucking dare ruin my time with him because you’re so desperate for a taste of affection that you’d sooner drink it from my pussy than take a second to grow the fuck up.
: The fuck is this? Since when are you this aggro about literally anything?
: I told you. I don’t have time for this anymore.
: And I’m not going to let you fuck up what little time I may have left with your petty insistence on being there during our most private moments.
: You want to tell everybody about it? Go ahead. Because I’d sure as fuck prefer being called a whore over having to spend one more second around your filthy fucking cunt.
scene furlough15
: And Sensei’s career? You’re suddenly fine with throwing that in the trash if it means the two of you get to fuck each other more privately from now on?
: Mhm.
: See! So you don’t want-
scene furlough16
: Wait, what?
: I don’t think shit will happen to Sensei’s career. Nor do I think you have the balls to actually tell anyone about this. Nor do I think anyone would believe a thirsty, jealous bitch like you.
scene furlough17
: You’ll regret saying that to me, you know. I might not be as popular as you, but people will still believe what I-
: The only thing I regret is letting things get to this point in the first place.
: If I had known back then what I know now, I would have hopped off his dick and slammed that door right in your fucking face.
: You should have been stuck outside of it like the fucking parasite you are...thriving off of what the two of us were doing together because you know damn well you’d die on your own.
: Parasite?...
: Well...
: Well at least I don’t have a fucking daddy complex that drove me to fucking my teacher in the first-
scene furlough18
: NGH-?!
: Why would you? Your parents don’t even like you. That’s why they spend all of their time and energy on Karin instead.
: So what if Sensei stepped in when my dad started neglecting me? So what if he filled a role I desperately needed someone to fill? We’re in love now and that’s all that matters.
: Meanwhile, you’re so fucking desperate for attention that I bet you’d let your actual father fill that loose cunt of yours if it meant making you feel alive for a fraction of a second.
scene furlough19
: Let...go...
: Shut the fuck up. I’m barely even squeezing.
: You think you’re...so much better...than me!
: Of course I do. I am better than you.
: I don’t get off on hurting people. I accept the parts of myself I’m not comfortable with.
: All you do is involve yourself in everyone else’s issues because the ones you have are so uninteresting and petty that they’re barely even issues at all.
: Get over yourself, Kirin. It’s very sad.
: But what’s even sadder is that, when I let go, you’re probably going to tell me that you still refuse to leave Sensei and me alone.
: But that wouldn’t be very good for you because, if you haven’t been able to figure it out so far, I don’t give a shit anymore.
: And I can ruin your life a hell of a lot easier than you can ruin mine.
scene furlough20
: Stop?...Sensei?...Sorry?...
: What are you trying to say? Speak up.
scene furlough21
: Science...fair!
scene furlough22
: Heh?
: The...science fair!
: This...never would have happened if...you just...didn’t beat me!
: You ruined...everything! I finally...could have...made my parents...proud of me!
scene furlough23
: If that never happened...I never would have wanted revenge...I never would have started watching you...being jealous of you...
: It’s all because you ruined the one thing in my life that I felt like I did well! You ruined it!
: Are you fucking kidding me?
scene furlough24
: It’s not funny!
: You...tried to ruin my life...over the fucking science fair?
: You...You ruined mine first! You-
scene furlough25
: Hah...hahah...hahaha...
: Hahahahahah!
: Why are you laughing? It’s not-
scene furlough26
: I'm laughing because you’re a fucking joke.
: I’m not a joke. Just because I’m not as lucky or gifted as you doesn’t mean I-
: No. You’re seriously a fucking joke.
: And if you ever try to come between Sensei and me again, I will snap your trachea like a twig.
scene furlough27
: D...Don’t laugh at me! Ayane!
: I wonder if Sensei and the others are back at home yet? I might still be able to catch up if I start running.
: Pay attention to me! This is serious!
scene furlough28
: What’s so serious about you wanting attention? That’s literally all you ever do. It’s pathetic. You’re pathetic. Trash. Worthless. Scum. Go fuck yourself.
: I just...I just wanted to feel like I-
: I don’t care.
: In fact, I kind of wish you were dead.
: Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I am going to go hang out with a group of people who enjoy my presence. Which is, coincidentally and quite hilariously, something you will never be able to do.
: There are...people who-
: No.
: There really aren’t, Kirin.
scene black
I heard from someone else that things went better than I thought they would.
How ironic.
I’ve grown so used to the slow burn of divine comedy that any punchline dissimilar to the feeling brought on by fiery coals beneath my feet is like an ice pack for an aneurysm.
It helps, but just slightly enough to distract me from the fact that everything is horrible and that it will all be over soon.
Or at least it would be in most cases.
The cycle would see otherwise.
But it seems the cycle can’t see at all.
For if it could, none of this would happen.
For if it could, things would never change.
It’s so interesting that they finally are.
